explication: Joomla is a PHP content-management system for building websites and web applications. In the administrator workflow, an administrator manages articles and supporting structures such as categories, fields, translations, and revisions; the CMS also provides banners, search indexing, configuration, and operational tools. The tree identifies these product areas, while the sampled controller source shows task dispatch and view/model coordination. Links between unsampled components are omitted rather than inferred; frontend rendering is not represented by this tree.
